note: The frozen column order of suggestions.csv. The shared WG7-TF2 spreadsheet imports that file with IMPORTDATA, which maps by position, so inserting or reordering a column silently shifts every formula, filter and note keyed to a column letter on the other side. New columns are appended, never inserted. tests/export.test.mjs pins this as a prefix, so appending passes and reordering does not.
